messages.author: 399bf2e734c020dc
messages.subject: INLA Crashing
parts:
Hi,

I am running a spatiotemporal model with quite a large number of data points and prediction points, when I try to change some of the hyperparameters of the model  (eg pc2matern sigma) the model runs but then crashed half way:

Iter=8 |grad|=35.7 |x-x.old|=0.0531 |f-f.old|=1.11 maxld= 26148.980 fn=332 theta= -0.097 3.450 5.470 0.993 1.506 [9.0, 3.37] 
maxld= 26148.999 fn=333 theta= -0.098 3.450 5.465 0.993 1.505 [9.0, 3.37] 
New directions for numerical gradient
 dir01      dir02      dir03      dir04      dir05 
0.227      0.900      0.286      0.227     -0.075 0.038     -0.015     -0.609      0.792      0.003 -0.070      0.172     -0.146     -0.109      0.966 -0.455     -0.216      0.664      0.528      0.166 0.858     -0.338      0.291      0.176      0.186 

Iter=9 |grad|=5.06 |x-x.old|=0.0272 |f-f.old|=0.502 
maxld= 26149.006 fn=347 theta= -0.097 3.452 5.463 0.992 1.503 [9.0, 3.33] 
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully. If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>. 

*** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2 Read ntt 6 1 with max.threads 12 Found num.threads = 6:1 max_threads = 6

can anyone offer some advice,

Kind regards,
Sylvan
